checks.ngram_containment: word 5-gram containment against the reference corpus as a whole
checks.normalized: NFC + casefold + punctuation strip + whitespace collapse
checks.shingle_jaccard: max character 5-gram Jaccard against any single reference row

closes: proposal.md Section 20.17 Phase A overlap and lineage audit
meta.expguard_not_covered: ExpGuard text is gated and never written to disk, so it is absent from this audit. Its disjointness from the teacher pool must be established separately under HF_TOKEN before any teacher training.

not_implemented.embedding_overlap: Section 20.6 also requires an embedding-space check. It needs a pinned encoder whose identity must enter the lock, so it belongs to the Phase A schema review, not to this script. This audit is therefore necessary but not sufficient for the Phase A gate.

meta.text_free: offending rows are identified by content_sha256 only

act1_id_test__vs__act1_train.why: id_test is a held-out-ROWS split of represented sources, so some lineage overlap is expected by construction; verbatim row reuse is not.

act1_id_test__vs__teacher_pool.why: Phase A: pool vs the represented evaluation split.

act1_train__vs__act1_calibration.why: control: train and calibration are both represented-source splits and should be row-disjoint, which makes this pair a check on the audit itself.

act1_transfer_test__vs__act1_train.why: roadmap item 2: the pending v2 decontamination audit. Leakage here would inflate measured transfer and make specialization look milder than it is.

act1_transfer_test__vs__teacher_pool.why: Phase A: the candidate teacher pool must not contaminate Act I's transfer suite.

teacher_pool__vs__act1_train.why: how much of the candidate teacher pool is already represented in Act I training.
